# Scott Wickenden

Scott Wickenden is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Scott Wickenden has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/scott-wickenden#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 33.1% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/scott-wickenden-2/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20160408040546/http://www.scottwickenden.com/#!mymanifesto/cjg9)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/scott-wickenden#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 with 40.5% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/scott-wickenden/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=il34iIsLkE0)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tu0uVu7AdYc)

Scott Wickenden has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/07/too-much-time-has-been-lost-to-political-infighting-former-minister-seeks-return-to-states/)\]

Links for Scott Wickenden:

- Twitter : [@Scott\_Wickenden](https://twitter.com/Scott_Wickenden)

## Election History

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-1) (3 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Scott Wickenden was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin)** |  | 946 | 65.8% |
| 2 | **[Russell Labey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/russell-labey)** |  | 811 | 56.4% |
| 3 | **Scott Wickenden** |  | 476 | 33.1% |
| 4 | [Shannen Kerrigan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/shannen-kerrigan) | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 355 | 24.7% |
| 5 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 311 | 21.6% |
| 6 | [Gino Risoli](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gino-risoli) |  | 192 | 13.4% |

1,437 ballots (inc. 26 spoilt papers)

5,333 registered voters

= 26.9% turnout
